chunks: Harun ibn Kharijah narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"When one of you intends a matter, he should not consult anyone among the people about it until he begins by consulting Allah, Blessed and Exalted."
He said: I said, "And what is consulting Allah, Blessed and Exalted? May I be your ransom."

He said: "He begins by seeking istikharah from Allah regarding it first, then he consults about it. For when he begins with Allah, Blessed and Exalted, He causes what is best for him to flow upon the tongue of whomever He wills from among the creation."

key_terms.أَمْرًا: a matter or undertaking a person intends to pursue
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the One first turned to for guidance
key_terms.الْخِيَرَةَ: the best choice or what is better
key_terms.فَيَسْتَخِيرُ: to seek istikharah, asking Allah to guide to the better choice
key_terms.لِسَانِ: the tongue, meaning the speech of those through whom guidance may come

ai.seo_question: How should a believer consult Allah before consulting people when making a decision?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that when a person intends to undertake a matter, he should first turn to Allah, Blessed and Exalted, before consulting people. The consultation of Allah is to seek istikharah first, after which counsel from others may become a means through which Allah directs the person to what is best.
